title: 第11章 杀手太穷连只鹅都嫌弃第12章 穷逼的金丹也是金丹
content_zh:
战斗是单方面的屠杀。
七个白衣杀手确实强。
他们练的都是杀人技，招招致命。
平时越级猎杀筑基巅峰都不在话下。
但他们今天碰上的是五行恶鬼。
这是陈邪万魂幡里的第二档战力，五个金丹境的凶魂。
金鬼周身散发庚金之气，一爪子挥过，直接把一个杀手的长刀连同半个肩膀切成两截。
木鬼化作无数带刺鬼藤，把两个杀手死死捆住，越勒越紧，骨头断裂的咔咔声在夜空里响起。
土鬼直接遁入地下，钻出抱住一个杀手的大腿，用力一扯，大腿齐根断裂。
惨叫声四起。
不过恶鬼没有直接杀人。
陈邪发过话，魂魄留着当口粮。
金鬼掐住一个杀手的脖子，张开大口用力一吸。
一个半透明魂体被硬生生从杀手天灵盖里扯出。
魂体挣扎，发出无声惨嚎。
金鬼一口吞下，砸了吧嘴。
不到半分钟，七个杀手全躺地上。
七具空壳，死状凄惨。
这还没完。
火鬼飘上前，张嘴吐出幽绿阴火。

阴火落在尸体上，没有高温，却将血肉骨骼烧成灰烬。
水鬼紧跟上前，嘴里喷出腥臭黑水，在柏油马路上冲刷一遍。
灰烬被冲走，地上血迹洗得干干净净。
毁尸灭迹，专业洗地，整个过程顺畅无比。
陈邪抱着胳膊，满意点头。
这业务能力，放外面保洁公司绝对是销冠。
萧逸站在车门边，整个人愣住。
他清楚陈邪是邪修，但没料到这货手底下的鬼这么专业。
杀人、抽魂、烧尸、洗地，一条龙服务。
连特么一点痕迹都没留！
这得干了多少票才能练出这种默契？
被大白鹅踩在脚底的杀手头头目眦欲裂。
他眼睁睁看着手下连骨灰都没剩下，心底升起绝望。
逃不掉。
绝对逃不掉。
杀手头头面具下的脸变形，咬破舌尖，体内金丹疯狂运转。
灵力在他气海里剧烈膨胀，毁灭性气息散发出来。
他要自爆！金丹境自爆，足以把这条高架桥炸断！
content_en:
The battle was a one-sided massacre.
The seven killers in white are indeed strong.
They practice killing skills and their moves are deadly.
It's no problem to jump through levels and hunt down the peak of foundation building.
But what they encountered today was the Five Elements Evil Ghost.
This is the second level of combat power in Chen Xie's Ten Thousand Soul Banner, five evil spirits in the Golden Core realm.
The golden ghost's whole body exuded the energy of Gengjin. He swung his claws and cut a killer's long knife into two pieces along with half of his shoulder.
The wooden ghost turned into countless thorny ghost vines and tied the two killers tightly, tightening them tighter and tighter. The cracking sound of broken bones sounded in the night sky.
The local ghost escaped directly into the ground, got out and hugged a killer's thigh, and pulled hard, and the thigh was broken at the root.
Screams were heard everywhere.
However, the evil spirit did not directly kill anyone.
Chen Xie had said that he would keep his soul as food.
The golden ghost grabbed a killer's neck, opened his mouth and sucked hard.
A translucent soul body was forcibly pulled out of the killer's heavenly spirit cover.
The soul struggled and let out a silent howl.
Jin Gui swallowed it in one gulp and smashed his mouth.
In less than half a minute, all seven killers were lying on the ground.
Seven empty shells, dead in a miserable state.
This is not over yet.
The fire ghost floated forward, opened his mouth and spit out green Yin fire.
The yin fire fell on the corpse, without high temperature, but burned the flesh and bones into ashes.
The water ghost followed closely, spitting out fishy black water from its mouth and washing it over the asphalt road.
The ashes were washed away, and the blood stains on the ground were washed clean.
The corpses were destroyed and traces were removed, and the floors were professionally cleaned. The whole process was smooth and smooth.
Chen Xie crossed his arms and nodded with satisfaction.
With this business ability, it is definitely the best selling cleaning company outside.
Xiao Yi stood by the car door, stunned.
He knew that Chen Xie was an evil cultivator, but he didn't expect that the ghost under this guy was so professional.
Killing people, extracting souls, burning corpses, washing floors, one-stop service.
Not even a single trace was left!
How many times does it take to develop this kind of tacit understanding?
The killer leader was trampled under his feet by the big white goose, and his eyes were about to burst.
He watched helplessly as no ashes were left among his men, and despair arose in his heart.
Can't escape.
There is absolutely no escape.
The face under the killer's mask was deformed, the tip of his tongue was bitten, and the golden elixir in his body was running wildly.
The spiritual power expanded violently in his Qi sea, and a destructive aura emitted.
He's going to blow himself up! The self-destruction of the Golden Core Realm is enough to blow up this viaduct!
